title: Iron Tests (Transferrin Saturation)
attribution: Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine.
measures: Transferrin saturation is reported as part of an iron panel, alongside serum iron and TIBC. MedlinePlus describes transferrin as the protein that moves iron through the body.
low: MedlinePlus does not separately describe low transferrin saturation on this page. For iron, a low result may point to iron deficiency anemia, another anemia or thalassemia.
high: MedlinePlus does not separately describe high transferrin saturation on this page. For iron, a high result may point to hemochromatosis, lead poisoning or liver disease.
notes: Iron panel results are interpreted together. Levels vary during the day, and medicines and the menstrual cycle can affect them.
